fixed_configuration.store: missions/generated/drafts — requires explicit authorization for these runs too (P05's covered only P05); before/after inventory per run

stop_conditions: Before the first run: suite SHA256SUMS, fixed_hashes.json, any of the 15 pinned sources, the provider/model or the config hash differ from the frozen values (never re-pin to continue).
Executor preflight not ok for the next case (any failed check).
Login, re-authentication or any manual intervention needed: stop before invoking and report ACCIÓN NECESARIA DE JOEL.
After a run: config not restored to its original hash, a user plugin left installed, or an own Hermes/MCP process still alive 15 s after the run.
Store incident: any file present in the before-inventory modified or removed (keep evidence, stop).
Two consecutive invocations without a final answer because of provider errors or timeouts (protocol of 24/10).
An evidence directory for the key already exists (never reused or overwritten).
The authorized number of invocations has been reached.
not_stop_conditions: A case failing its acceptance (wrong tool, invented value, wrong finalization, technical failure of one run) is a RESULT: record it and continue with the next key after the pause. No key is ever relaunched.
accounting_per_run: process execution (invocations, return code, timeout, elapsed)
normal provider calls (main logical requests, auxiliary)
internal attempts observed (llm_error events, failed attempts)
